T16_vs_T32.note: Observational comparison, not an intervention isolating idle agents

prediction_check.interpretation: Report observed distances and all failures; near/far lack a prespecified formal decision threshold. Do not refit the pre-run predictions using these observations.

limits: Three seeds, 16 agents, fixed grain4 DAG only. Full four-edge apply chains audited for accepted tasks; integer verifier does not enforce query counts for arbitrary strategies. Single-agent baseline from the prior grain4 run; new run usage excludes that baseline and all development/chat use. Historical 32-agent runs are provided separately and excluded from usage. Idle-agent coordination is a hypothesis, not a causal conclusion from elapsed rounds alone. Predictions frozen before launch under a064fb7; do not infer a universal law or tune on these seeds.
